liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Alabama Getaway** (2 reviews): Opener fit the state and Go To Heaven's release; reviewer counts it among the show's highlights; Alabama into Promised Land opener is described as full of energy [11][20]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): China Cat into Rider is called ripping, and the Other One has an interesting lead-in; China>Rider>Samson sequence is scorching but extremely short [10][11]
- **Goin' Down the Road Feelin' Bad** (2 reviews): Brent's playing is singled out as outstanding in Going Down the Road; Reviewer says the unusual encore was a salute to Healy, who was in tears at the board [14][18]
- **Althea** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Althea blistering [12]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): He's Gone and the Other One are short but intense [20]

## The recordings

- **gd80-04-28.fob-nak700.non-dank.3402.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 139 min; rated 4.4/5 by 15 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is crisp with good stereo separation; crowd noise is present but not overwhelming [16]
- **gd1980-04-28.163782.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 142 min [2]
- **gd1980-04-28.fob.glassberg.motb.0040.88858.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 143 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [4]. Said about its sound: A PA glitch during I Know You Rider was removed, and other glitches and a tape flip were crossfaded [4]
- **gd1980-04-28.fob.glassberg.motb.0040.88906.sbeok.flac24**: source not stated; 21 songs; 143 min [6]. Said about its sound: A PA glitch in I Know You Rider was removed; glitches and a tape flip were crossfaded [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer met Jerry and Bob behind Boutwell before the show; they signed copies of Go To Heaven and posed for photos [9]
- Reviewer's group slipped inside and watched Phil set up and play alone; he chatted with them from the stage [9]
- Reviewer says this was the band's last show in Alabama [10]
- Songs are short, yet played with a ferocity rarely heard in 1980 [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd80-04-28.fob-nak700.non-dank.3402.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by Jim Wise; source: Audience Recording: Nakamichi 700 [1]. Also: Source is Nakamichi 700 FOB to Sony TC-D5 master cassette, then Tascam 112mkIII, DAT, CDR, and SHN [1]
- **gd1980-04-28.163782.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5 [2]. Also: Bob Wagner and Barry Glassberg each ran one Nakamichi 700 mic and a D5 deck, pairing mics together; Charlie Miller did the transfer; Bob Morris's Sony ECM990 source supplies some crowd sound [2]
- **gd1980-04-28.fob.glassberg.motb.0040.88858.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Barry Glassberg and Robert Wagner; transferred by A. Egert and D. McCabe; source: 2 x Nakamichi CM-700 [15 dB Attenuation Pad] > Sony TC-D5M > MAC [4]
- **gd1980-04-28.fob.glassberg.motb.0040.88906.sbeok.flac24**: taped by Barry Glassberg and Robert Wagner; transferred by A. Egert and D. McCabe; source: 2 x Nakamichi CM-700 [15 dB Attenuation Pad] > Sony TC-D5M > MAC [6]
